steps.note: Acid is added to bring the whey to a lower pH before and during the hold, so the whey protein will come out.
The whey is warmed in a heat exchanger, then taken up to temperature by direct steam injection and held in a tube while the protein precipitates.
A solids-ejecting centrifuge takes out the soft coagulum as a 12 to 15 percent solids concentrate, 90 to 95 percent of the coagulable protein.
